verdict.rationale: Meilisearch is documented as API-first: documents, embeddings, full-text, semantic and conversational search are all exposed 'from a single API' [docs-1]. Index creation, document ingestion, settings and search are scriptable through typed SDKs and the official MCP server [docs-13, docs-43, docs-50]. Per-index settings such as typo tolerance and ranking rules are configurable [docs-23, docs-31], and the web interface is only described as a convenience for a first search [docs-2]. missing for 10: an explicit statement of API/UI parity, evidence that Cloud-dashboard functions (project creation, analytics) are available via API, a publicly discoverable OpenAPI spec (probed paths returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.
